notes.title: Demo v3 is now out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797699/336b5646abea517ed3a4c4c9ff2edceeb672f27b.gif[/img]

[h3]New demo available! Significant changes and updates to go through.[/h3]

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Checkpoint system - you can now set checkpoints during levels to save temporary progress
[*] Key and lock system - you can now add keys in levels for players to collect in order to unlock doors and dynamic paths
[*] Inventory System - each hand has an inventory slot. health, keys, etc. can be placed in slot
[*] Treasure System - can add treasure to levels to be collected. 
[/list]

[h2]Locomotion Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Camera based walking -  now is the default, with option to switch to controller direction
[*] Coyote Jump - preparing for jump you know enter a slide state which keeps momentum if jumping fast enough. This allows for increasingly longer jumps when chained together, and the ability to maintain momentum upon landing from a jump.
[/list]

[h2]Level Editor Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Snapping - turn on grid snapping to more easily align agents to each other and terrain
[*] Locked Doors- requires key to unlock
[*] Dynamic Paths - set a path in the editor that will generate terrain during the level when the player places a key on the pedestal
[*] Treasure Chests - add treasure chests to levels for optional challenge
[*] Spiker - new obstacle
[*] Crusher - new obstacle
[/list]

[h2]General Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new levels  
[*] Tracks time of completion for levels
[*] Tracks treasure collected per level
[*] New graphics and textures for agents
[*] FX updates and audio updates
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]


Starting next week I will be implementing a new method of distributing updates so folks interested have access to more current builds. Stay turned for more info! 

As always, for more info join our Discord community: [url=https://discord.gg/NHjARMVtKG]https://discord.gg/NHjARMVtKG[/url]

Thanks for reading,

-r

notes.title: Traverse The Void Demo 2 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797699/b0757dd0f96e933d6ab75711ba175dff81de15ad.gif[/img]

Second demo of the game is now live. Below is a list of additions and fixes. As always, I am very appreciative of feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797699/aba977522ce76c1fea7a84cb1b97de45e388b1ee.gif[/img]

[h1]Demo 2[/h1]
[b]v0.1.3[/b]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Voxel Types: Terrain can now be painted different textures. Each texture or "type" has different properties of: durability, climbable, dps.
[*] Parenting: Dragging an agent on top of another parents them together. This is how you can make a moving path. The UI for parenting needs some work, which will be in the next update.
[*] Paths: You can now draw paths (for now only strait lines). An agent attached to the path will move along it. 
[*] Player movement updates: players movement is faster, with some improvements to grab detection.
[*] Info Spheres in levels: Yo can now add text in levels using info spheres.
[*] Added 4 new levels
[*] Save migrations. As I will undoubtedly break old saves quite a lot early on, the game detects an older save and will migrate the file to the new version.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where player would launch into the sky...:P
[*] Fixed choppiness of walking
[*] Added strafing
[*] More info spheres in Hub
[*] Added info spheres to level editor
[*] Reset gravity on level exit
[*] general bug fixes and things I forgot I fixed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797699/16e425af58a429d431838caf94d915fc3bce0ff5.gif[/img]
